summary: The candidate’s queue implementation and deterministic checks satisfy the non-ledger acceptance criteria. All supplied AC-1 through AC-4 commands exited 0; focused tests cover queue bounds, allocation failures, queued and running cancellation, generation suppression, current-generation results, and the owner-quiescence death test. The 1,000-cycle smoke reports zero stale publications and joins below the 2-second limit. Pending ledger acceptance and the documented revision-1 terminal preflight block did not affect this verdict.
